title: Online Bidder
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Online Bidder** to identify business opportunities, submit customized proposals, and generate qualified leads through freelance marketplaces, agency directories, tender portals, and other online platforms.

You will research available projects, understand client requirements, identify opportunities that match our services, prepare compelling proposals, respond to enquiries, and follow up with potential clients to help win new business.

This role is suitable for freshers who have strong research and communication skills, as well as experienced candidates with a background in online bidding, freelance platforms, tender research, or business development.

**Our goal is to generate relevant business opportunities through targeted bidding, quality proposals, and consistent follow-ups.**

Key Responsibilities1. Online Project Research & Opportunity Identification

* Search for relevant projects and business opportunities on Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer, PeoplePerHour, and other freelance platforms.
* Explore agency directories such as GoodFirms and DesignRush to identify potential clients and business opportunities.
* Monitor relevant tender portals, procurement websites, and online business opportunity platforms.
* Review project descriptions, budgets, timelines, client requirements, and competition before deciding whether to bid.
* Identify opportunities related to digital marketing, website development, design, and other services offered by the agency.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of suitable projects and potential clients.

2. Proposal Writing & Online Bidding

* Prepare customized proposals based on each client's requirements and business objectives.
* Write clear, persuasive, and professional bid responses that explain how our services address the client's needs.
* Highlight relevant capabilities, experience, and project approaches while ensuring all claims are accurate.
* Tailor proposals to the platform, project scope, budget, and expected deliverables.
* Submit bids within deadlines and follow platform-specific submission requirements.
* Avoid generic proposals and prioritize projects that align with our services and capabilities.

3. Requirement Analysis & Opportunity Qualification

* Read and analyze project descriptions, tender documents, and client enquiries carefully.
* Assess project suitability based on service requirements, budget, timeline, and business potential.
* Identify missing information and prepare relevant questions when clarification is needed.
* Prioritize opportunities based on relevance, feasibility, and likelihood of progressing.
* Coordinate with the internal team to confirm technical requirements, scope, pricing inputs, or other information needed for proposals.

4. Client Communication & Follow-Ups

* Respond professionally to client messages, enquiries, and requests for additional information.
* Follow up on submitted proposals and pending opportunities at appropriate intervals.
* Coordinate discussions, meetings, and next steps with interested prospects.
* Maintain timely communication throughout the bidding and initial sales process.
* Help move promising opportunities toward discussions, negotiations, and project confirmation.

5. Bid Tracking & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of projects identified, proposals submitted, responses received, and follow-ups completed.
* Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, or internal tracking tools with the latest opportunity status.
* Track proposal success rates, qualified opportunities, client responses, and projects won.
* Identify which platforms, project categories, and proposal approaches generate the best results.
* Prepare regular reports on bidding activity, pipeline quality, and business development performance.
* Recommend improvements to targeting, proposal quality, and follow-up processes.

Platforms & Tools

* **Freelance Marketplaces:** Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer, PeoplePerHour
* **Agency Directories:** GoodFirms, DesignRush, and similar platforms
* **Tender & Procurement Research:** Relevant tender portals and business opportunity websites
* **Business Research:** Google Search and online directories
* **Bid Management:** CRM software, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* **Communication & Productivity:** Email, messaging platforms, document tools, and AI writing assistants

Skills & Qualifications

* Good written English and professional communication skills.
* Ability to understand client requirements and identify suitable business opportunities.
* Strong proposal-writing, research, and information-gathering skills.
* Familiarity with online bidding, freelance marketplaces, or business development.
* Ability to prepare customized proposals rather than rely on generic templates.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing, website development, graphic design, or other agency services.
* Good organizational skills and the ability to manage deadlines and follow-ups.
* Familiarity with spreadsheets, CRM systems, and opportunity tracking.
* A proactive attitude and willingness to learn new platforms and bidding strategies.
* Ability to work toward business development and lead generation targets.

Experience Requirements

**Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.**

Freshers with strong communication, research, and proposal-writing skills can apply, even if they have not previously managed paid freelance platform accounts.

Candidates with experience in online bidding, Upwork proposals, freelance marketplace management, tender research, agency directories, proposal coordination, or online business development will be preferred.

How Success Is Measured

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Relevance and quality of projects identified.
* Quality and customization of submitted proposals.
* Qualified leads and client conversations generated.
* Responses received and opportunities progressing to the next stage.
* Projects won and contribution to business development.
* Timely follow-ups and accurate opportunity tracking.
* Improvement in proposal effectiveness and bidding strategy.

We prioritize **relevant opportunities, strong proposals, and genuine business potential over the sheer volume of bids submitted.**

Who Should Apply?

This role is ideal for freshers, online bidders, proposal writers, freelance platform executives, tender research executives, and business development candidates who want to build a career in online business generation.

If you can understand client requirements, identify the right projects, write persuasive proposals, and consistently follow up on opportunities, we encourage you to apply.

**Apply now to help us discover new projects, connect with potential clients, and generate business opportunities through online platforms.**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Motion Artist / Video Editor
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Industry: Marketing Services

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

  

Min Experience: 4+ years  
JobType: full-time

**Joining:** Immediate

**Location:** Candidates should be based in Delhi/NCR and must be open to both remote and work-from-office arrangements, as the final working model is yet to be confirmed by the client. They should be flexible to work from the office if required

**About the Role**

The client is looking for an experienced Senior Motion Artist / Video Editor to join a regional creative team producing rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. Working in close partnership with client stakeholders and a distributed global team, this role will transform existing footage, design assets and approved content into polished, engaging video and motion deliverables.

The ideal candidate combines strong editing instincts with motion-design expertise. They should be equally comfortable shaping an edit, animating graphics and timing visuals to audio, while working closely with the design team to maintain a cohesive visual system.

An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.

**Requirements**
----------------

### **In This Role, They Will**

* Edit existing footage and approved content into clear, engaging video deliverables.
* Create motion graphics, animated typography, transitions and supporting visual elements.
* Apply established brand guidelines, motion principles and design systems across all work.
* Use existing content thoughtfully to make technical and editorial stories more dynamic and accessible.
* Time edits and animation precisely to voiceover, music and other audio elements.
* Partner with designers to adapt static assets, layouts, charts and graphics for motion.
* Work with technical writers and producers to maintain narrative clarity and content accuracy.
* Interpret briefs and feedback independently, identifying gaps and asking focused questions when needed.
* Create efficient workflows and reusable motion components that support rapid-turn production.
* Prepare organized project files that can be easily understood and continued by distributed teams.
* Support clear, documented handoffs when work continues across regions or shifts.
* Conduct thorough self-QA across visual quality, timing, audio, spelling, brand alignment, specifications and version control.
* Incorporate feedback quickly while maintaining craft and consistency.
* Use approved AI and creative technology tools to support editing, animation and production efficiency.
* Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

### **Experience Required:**

* 5+ years of experience in motion design, video editing or post-production within an agency, technology company or in-house creative organization.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.
* Working proficiency in Figma, including navigating files, reviewing components and exporting production-ready assets.
* Strong motion-graphics, animation and editorial storytelling skills.
* Experience working with existing footage, static design assets, voiceover and music.
* Strong understanding of pacing, timing, composition, typography and audio synchronization.
* Ability to animate charts, diagrams and technical information clearly and accurately.
* Familiarity with established brand systems, templates and reusable motion toolkits.
* Strong file organization, version-control and self-QA practices.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage rapid turnarounds and maintain quality when priorities shift.
* Experience collaborating across regions, time zones and shift-based teams.
* Ability to work on assigned nontraditional shifts and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday rotations.
* Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required, as all briefs, feedback and creative deliverables will be in English.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills.

### **AI Experience – Mandatory**

* Hands-on experience using AI tools in creative/video production is mandatory.
* Candidates must mention the AI tools they have worked with when sharing their profiles.
* Portfolios should highlight AI-led/AI-assisted work separately

### **Working Model**

This is a hybrid, shift-based role supporting a global production model. Working hours will vary by assigned shift and may include early mornings, evenings, overnight coverage or other nontraditional schedules. Participation in a planned weekend and holiday rotation will also be required. Schedules will be established in advance, with some flexibility needed around urgent priorities and cross-regional handoffs.

The current shift is **8 hours/day, 1:00 AM–9:00 AM PDT**. Shift timings may change based on business requirements, so flexibility across different shift timings is mandatory. Shifts will be rotational and planned accordingly amongst the talents.

The role requires **5 working days per week, including Saturdays and Sundays**. Candidates must be comfortable working on weekends.

Schedules will generally be communicated in advance, but candidates should be flexible to support **urgent priorities and cross-regional handoffs** when required.

Once selected, the talent must be **available to start immediately**

**Non - negotiables:**  
1. Flexibility around timings and weekend availability to work with international clients across time zones

2. Hands-on experience using AI tools in creative/video production is mandatory. AI work should be highlighted separately

3. Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.

**Must-have skills**

After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, AI

title: Content Writer - Vedanta Sakhi-ME Project
description:
**POSITION:** Content Lead
  
**REPORTS TO:** Marketing Head

**LOCATION:** Delhi
  
**LEVEL/GRADE:** ECC

**About ACCESS:**
  
ACCESS Development Services is a national livelihoods promotion organization with a focus on incubating innovations and developing sustainable models for livelihoods promotion of the poor. To this end, ACCESS is structured uniquely to work at all levels of the value chain – implementing programmes on the ground (Tier I), working with Civil Society Organizations, Government Departments, Corporate sector, and Multilateral / Bilateral Agencies (Tier II) as also undertaking national initiatives to influence and support policy initiatives and strengthening the enabling environment (Tier III). ACCESS, with its head office in New Delhi has a pan-India presence. More at www.accessdev.org

**Project Summary – SAKHI Utpadan Samiti :**  
Sakhi, a flagship CSR initiative of Hindustan Zinc (Vedanta Group), empowers rural women in Rajasthan and Uttarakhand through sustainable livelihoods. Since 2016, it has mobilized thousands into Self Help Groups (SHGs), fostering entrepreneurship and economic participation.

Established in 2018 as an ISO 9001-certified enterprise, Sakhi Utpadan Samiti offers over 200 textile and 70+ food products through a growing network of 250 retail stores.

Through its brands—heartswithfingers, DaiChi, and Upaya Sakhi—it connects women artisans directly to markets, enabling consumers to make responsible purchases that benefit the makers.

Committed to inclusivity, entrepreneurship, and sustainability, Sakhi strengthens rural value chains and promotes economic independence and dignity for women in its communities.

**Position Summary:**

**Position Overview**
  
We are seeking a versatile Content Lead and Strategic Storyteller to amplify the impact of the Sakhi Program. You will bridge grassroots artisan stories with high-converting commercial copy—handling everything from high-velocity E-commerce marketplace content (Amazon A+, Flipkart, Website) to corporate communications (Annual Reports, CXO LinkedIn engagement, impact case studies).

**Responsibilities:**

**1. E-Commerce & Marketplace Content (Conversion Focus)**

* **Website Content (Heartswithfingers.com):** Own product landing pages, banner copy, SEO product descriptions, and the execution of the “Meet the Maker” interactive program to showcase artisan provenance.

**2. Impact Storytelling & Corporate Communications**

* **Women Case Studies:** Travel to field locations (Rajasthan/Uttarakhand) to interview rural women entrepreneurs, crafting inspiring, human-centric impact profiles for internal and external stakeholders.
* **Annual Reports & ESG Collateral:** Research, write, and curate content sections for the Sakhi/Vedanta CSR Annual Report, impact coffee-table books, and investor/donor updates.

**3. Social Media & Executive LinkedIn Branding**

* **CXO & B2B LinkedIn Strategy:** Draft authoritative, thought-leadership posts for senior executives and program heads to engage CXOs, corporate buyers, and ESG influencers.
* **Instagram & Visual Content:** Plan and write engaging reels captions, carousel copy, and lifestyle content showcasing the journey from rural artisans to modern kitchens.

**4. Collateral & Sales Enablement**
  
Draft B2B brand catalogues, pitch decks, corporate gifting brochures (e.g., Rakhi/Diwali kits), and email newsletters targeting corporate accounts and modern trade partners.

**Key Qualifications & Skills:**

* **Experience:** 3–4 years of experience in copywriting, content creation, or brand communications within FMCG, D2C, social enterprise, or agency environments.
* **E-Commerce Copywriting:** Proven track record of creating Amazon A+ content, SEO product listings, and digital marketplace collateral.
* **B2B & Thought Leadership Writing:** Ability to write polished, executive-ready posts and corporate report content.
* **Storytelling Muscle:** Strong interviewing skills with the empathy to capture grassroots rural narratives accurately.
* **Languages:** Fluent in English and Hindi (spoken and written) for smooth field-level interviews and corporate drafting.

The salary for this position is fixed at ₹50,000 per month (ECC level).

title: Documentation Officer
description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented, experienced, and proactive **Documentation Officer** to manage post-sales client file preparation, documentation workflows, and visa application lodgements. The ideal candidate will possess hands-on expertise in handling permanent residency (PR), work permits, and tourist visa documentation for major Western destinations—specifically **Canada, Australia, and Germany**—along with proficiency in scheduling appointments at VFS Global and respective Embassies/High Commissions.

**Key Responsibilities & Core Duties1. Visa & Immigration Documentation Management**

* **PR & Work Visas:** Manage end-to-end documentation for Canada PR, Australia PR, and Germany Work Permits, ensuring strict adherence to current immigration laws, checklists, and regulatory guidelines.
* **Tourist & Visitor Visas:** Handle comprehensive documentation, cover letter drafting, financial proof compilation, and application filing for tourist visas across all major Western countries (e.g., USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Schengen/European nations).
* **Quality Control:** Thoroughly audit client credentials, educational transcripts, employment reference letters, financial statements, and civil documents to ensure 100% accuracy before submission.

**2. Post-Sales Client Management & Guidance**

* **Client Coordination:** Act as the primary post-sales point of contact for clients, guiding them step-by-step through the document collection and file compilation process.
* **Visa Success Strategy:** Counsel and guide clients on optimizing their profile strengths, gathering robust supporting evidence, and meeting stringent visa requirements to maximize the probability of visa success.
* **Query Resolution:** Address client queries regarding documentation timelines, visa formalities, and procedural updates with professionalism and clarity.

**3. Embassy, VFS & Portal Operations**

* **Appointment Bookings:** Expertly navigate and manage online portal slots to book biometric and interview appointments at **VFS Global centers** and various **Embassies/High Commissions**.
* **Application Lodgement:** Handle online visa submissions, visa fee payments, submission of passport/courier dispatches, and tracking of active application statuses.

**4. Multi-Tasking & Administrative Support**

* Maintain up-to-date physical and digital records (CRM/tracking sheets) of all assigned client files, tracking status milestones from initiation to decision.
* Coordinate with internal sales and counselling teams to ensure a smooth transition of clients from pre-sales conversion to post-sales processing.
* Handle diverse administrative tasks related to client file dispatch, translation coordination (if required), and compliance documentation.

**Candidate Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum 2–4 years of proven work experience as a Documentation Officer, Visa Filing Expert, or Immigration Process Consultant within a reputed immigration/travel consultancy firm.
* **Geographical Expertise:** In-depth knowledge of immigration pathways, visa subclasses, and document checklists for **Canada, Australia, Germany, and Western tourist destinations**.
* **Technical Skills:** Hands-on experience with VFS booking systems, embassy submission portals, MS Office, and CRM/document management software.
* **Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to handle high-volume files under tight deadlines while maintaining client satisfaction.

description:
**Job Description – Proofreader**  
**Role Summary**

Proofreaders at Educart are responsible for identifying and correcting grammatical, typographical, formatting, and technical errors in written documents by comparing them with the original manuscripts. title: Head of Design
description:
Candidates with a minimum of 10\+ years of dedicated experience in Commercial Office Interior Architecture \& Design only eligible.


**Role Definition**


The Head of Design holds total executive accountability for the creative vision, technical accuracy, commercial viability, and execution readiness of every design project at Divine Innovation. Directing a full multidisciplinary studio—including interior architects, 3D visualizers, furniture designers, proposal writers, and BOQ estimators—this leader translates sales downloads into awe\-inspiring, budget\-aligned workspace environments. The Head of Design personally checks all drawing packages to ensure 100% zero\-ambiguity handovers to project execution and purchase teams, while co\-leading design pitches to leave enterprise clients flabbergasted.

**Responsibilities \& Deliverables**

* **Creative Direction \& Enterprise Client Pitching:** Lead the design studio in crafting innovative commercial office concepts, while personally joining the Sales team to present and defend high\-ticket enterprise design pitches.
* **Airtight Technical Documentation \& Execution Handoff:** Rigorously check and vet 100% of technical drawings (GFCs, MEP, civil, ceiling, layout) to ensure project execution teams receive flawless packages requiring zero back\-and\-forth clarification.
* **Design\-to\-Budget \& BOQ Governance:** Direct the in\-house BOQ and proposal team to ensure all creative concepts strictly adhere to targeted client budgets and Divine Innovation’s gross margin requirements.
* **Factory Integration \& Furniture Design Leadership:** Oversee the internal furniture design team to produce precise, production\-ready factory shop drawings for custom joinery and workstations manufactured at the IMT Manesar plant.

**Tasks and Activities**

**1\. Creative Direction \& Enterprise Client Pitching**

* Take comprehensive project downloads from the Sales team, converting client headcount, aesthetic, and functional requirements into world\-class design solutions.
* Direct and mentor the studio team (interior designers, 3D renderers, space planners) to deliver designs that exceed client expectations ("happily flabbergast" the client).
* Partner with Sales Managers on key enterprise accounts to lead design presentations, walk CXOs through 3D models, and articulate design rationale.
* Enforce strict adherence to Divine Innovation's Process System Structure (PSS) for design SLA turnaround times from sales download to proposal delivery.

**2\. Airtight Technical Documentation \& Execution Handoff**

* Personally review, mark up, and approve 100% of drawing packages generated by the studio prior to client sign\-off and site release.
* Deliver complete, hyper\-detailed Good for Construction (GFC) drawing dockets to the Head of Projects, eliminating any need for execution teams to seek mid\-project clarifications.
* Write crystal\-clear material specifications, bill\-of\-materials (BOM), and procurement notes so non\-technical Purchase team members can source exact items effortlessly.

**3\. Design\-to\-Budget \& BOQ Governance**

* Supervise proposal and BOQ estimators to build detailed cost breakdowns alongside design development.
* Enforce "Design\-to\-Budget" principles: either design strictly within an established client budget or establish a baseline BOQ that protects target gross margins.
* Review all pre\-bid BOQs and techno\-commercial proposals for line\-item accuracy, material specification alignment, and commercial safety before client submission.

**4\. Factory Integration \& Furniture Design Leadership**

* Lead the dedicated Furniture Design team in developing custom modular workstations, executive desks, and loose furniture concepts.
* Ensure creation of millimeter\-accurate factory shop drawings (joinery details, hardware specs, finish schedules) for seamless production at the IMT Manesar manufacturing plant.
* Coordinate with the IMT Manesar production team to verify prototype feasibility, material availability, and manufacturing standards.

**Measurement Metrics**

* **Zero\-Query Handoff Rate:** 100% zero\-query technical handovers (Project execution team proceeds without requiring drawing clarifications).
* **Design SLA Adherence:** 100% compliance with internal PSS turnaround timelines from sales download to initial proposal presentation.
* **Design\-to\-Budget Accuracy:** 100% budget compliance with zero margin degradation caused by design oversights or unbudgeted material specs.
* **Enterprise Pitch Win Rate:** Contribution to achieving a 30%\+ win rate on key enterprise pitch presentations.
* **Non\-Technical Purchase Execution:** 0 purchasing errors resulting from vague or incomplete design specifications.

**Competencies We Are Looking For**

**Skills**

* Creative Design Leadership \& Commercial Workspace Concept Design
* High\-Impact Enterprise Client Pitching \& CXO Presentation
* Rigorous Technical Drawing Verification \& Detail Auditing (CAD/Revit/BIM)
* Design\-to\-Budget Engineering \& BOQ Estimation Governance
* Factory Shop Drawing Review (Modular Joinery \& Furniture Manufacturing)
* Cross\-Functional Specification Writing for Procurement Teams

**Knowledge**

* Deep expertise in commercial workplace architecture, space planning ratios, and ergonomics
* Thorough understanding of civil, MEP, HVAC, acoustic, lighting, and fire safety systems
* Material costs, finishing techniques, and commercial fit\-out procurement workflows
* Industrial furniture manufacturing processes, wood/metal joinery, and production workflows (IMT Manesar setup)

**Self\-Image**

* Master Design \& Technical Authority
* Creative Visionary with Commercial Discipline
* Flawless Execution Enabler

**Traits**

* Obsessive attention to technical detail and drawing accuracy
* High aesthetic sensibility combined with practical buildability
* Articulate, charismatic communicator with executive presence
* Calm under tight SLA pressure and multi\-project demands

**Motives**

* Driven by creating iconic, award\-worthy corporate workspace environments
* Motivated by technical perfection and zero\-error project execution
* Committed to building a seamless bridge between design creativity, manufacturing, and site delivery
